query: Where is Ram Head located?
table:
Document 1
Title: Rame Head
Text: Rame Head Rame Head or Ram Head () is a coastal headland, southwest of the village of Rame in southeast Cornwall, United Kingdom. It is part of the larger Rame Peninsula.
